_source: readAddressRoles on the public node, 18/10/2026, for the SIRIUS holders and launch recipients.

roles.name: Virtuals’ capital-formation wallet (ACF)
roles.detail: Virtuals’ wallet for Automated Capital Formation: it receives 25% of every launch that uses it, and sells it through pools it fills as the price rises, the proceeds going to the team. It is not locked.
roles.evidence: received 25% of the supply from Virtuals’ reserve wallet on every ACF launch sampled (SIRIUS, UMBRA, MIKO, SYNA, POPHIE, HOUSE)

roles.name: a batch contract of Virtuals’ capital-formation wallet
roles.detail: A contract the capital-formation wallet sends tokens through to fill its pools; what it holds is waiting to be placed in a pool.
roles.evidence: received 70.5 M SIRIUS from the capital-formation wallet on 23/09/2026 and put 50.5 M in the V3 pool against USDG in one transaction (0x5a20a246…)

roles.name: Virtuals’ reserve wallet
roles.detail: The wallet Virtuals’ launchpad sends the reserved part of a launch to; it hands it out within minutes.

roles.name: Virtuals’ launch curve
roles.detail: Where the token is first sold, before it moves to an open market: buyers buy from it, and what is left moves to the market at graduation.
roles.evidence: named as the curve in the launch event

roles.name: Virtuals’ team lock (TokenTable)
roles.detail: Its tokens unlock on a schedule; Virtuals’ reserve wallet manages it and can still cancel schedules and withdraw the deposit.

roles.name: a smart-contract wallet
roles.detail: An ERC-4337 account: a wallet run by a contract, for a person or a service.

roles.name: a V3 trading pool against USDG
roles.detail: A Uniswap V3-style pool trading this token against USDG: what it holds is liquidity, not anyone’s position.
roles.evidence: token0()/token1() name this token, fee() answers
